title: From Suboptimal to Optimal: One-Step Latent Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.16984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn effective policies from fixed datasets without environment interaction. Although generative models such as diffusion and flow matching enhance policy expressiveness, they typically start from uninformative Gaussian noise and generate actions through multi-step iteration, leading to high computational costs and failing to effectively leverage suboptimal trajectories in datasets. We propose MeanFlow2Better (MF2B), which reformulates offline RL as generative decision chunk optimization from current performance status to better performance status in a high-level latent decision space. MF2B maps trajectory chunks to high-level latent decision representations through an encoder, placing generation starting points within a structured decision space sculpted by behavioral data. The model learns a shared conditional mean velocity field in this space, constructing two flow mappings: from Gaussian-Indu

translated_title: 从次优到最优：面向离线强化学习的一步潜空间流策略
translated_abstract: 离线强化学习旨在从固定数据集中学习有效策略，而无需与环境进行交互。尽管扩散模型和流匹配等生成模型提升了策略的表达能力，但它们通常从不含信息的高斯噪声出发，通过多步迭代生成动作，导致计算成本高昂，并且无法有效利用数据集中的次优轨迹。我们提出 MeanFlow2Better（MF2B），将离线强化学习重新表述为在高层潜决策空间中从当前性能状态到更优性能状态的生成式决策块优化。MF2B 通过编码器将轨迹块映射到高层潜决策表示，使生成起点位于由行为数据塑造的结构化决策空间之内。该模型在此空间中学习一个共享的条件平均速度场，构建两个流映射：从高斯诱导……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 MeanFlow2Better（MF2B），通过编码器将轨迹块映射到由行为数据塑造的高层潜决策空间，并学习共享条件平均速度场构建双流映射，将离线强化学习重构为从当前性能到更优性能的一步生成式决策块优化，从而降低多步迭代开销并有效利用数据集中的次优轨迹。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MeanFlow2Better (MF2B), which reformulates offline RL as one-step generative decision-chunk optimization from current to better performance states by encoding trajectory chunks into a behaviorally-structured high-level latent decision space and learning a shared conditional mean velocity field, thereby reducing multi-step generation costs while effectively leveraging suboptimal trajectories.
